## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Existing props, events, slots and markup behave as before (`tests/compat` is green), or the change is opt-in
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` of each changed package updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] README updated for any new option, event or entry point
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
